verdict: Lead volume is low and cost per lead rose; five setup milestones are being resolved.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 27 leads at a blended cost per lead of $150.97 across $4,076 in total ad spend — a structurally low volume for the budget in play. Lead volume dropped 50% week-over-week, driven by a roughly 52% pullback in Google Ads spend that compressed delivery without improving efficiency, pushing cost per lead up 21% in the same window. Separately, five foundational setup items — pre-launch testing, LSA verification, site and landing pages, and Meta retargeting — remain undelivered, now nearly two months past their due dates; until those are closed, true attribution and efficiency measurement are limited. On the intake side, 125 opportunities entered your CRM this period from 460 contacts, but zero consults were booked, which points to a follow-up gap rather than an ad delivery problem, and that pipeline process is being tightened now. Google Ads spend is being stabilized and the overdue milestones are being resolved this week; expect more reliable lead tracking and steadier volume in the next reporting period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days across all paid channels
blended cost per lead this period, up 21% from last week
consults booked from 125 CRM opportunities — intake follow-up is being addressed

watch_item.issue: Five SOW milestones — including LSA verification, landing pages, and Meta retargeting — are 55+ days overdue, limiting what attribution can confirm.
watch_item.fix: These items are being closed out this week so full tracking and lead source reporting can be established.
